description: Weekly dependency PRs (Mend Renovate GitHub App). Same shape in every hnykda app repo; infra config lives in hnykda/server-files renovate.json.
No automerge: PRs get no CI (Woodpecker here only builds+deploys on push to main), so merging is the test. Merge = rebuild + deploy.

packageRules.description: Our own images in the in-cluster registry (tag = commit SHA set by CI).
engines.node moves deliberately with the Dockerfile base image.
One weekly PR for all non-major npm updates.
One weekly PR for Dockerfile base images + CI step images (node 24 / nginx 1.31 lines; majors separate).

Library majors (TS 7, ESLint 10, Tailwind 4, zod 4, ...) mostly carry no security value (2026-10-03 sweep: skip unless needed): listed on the dependency dashboard, tick the box to get the PR. Vulnerability fixes bypass this. Docker/helm/CI majors still open PRs directly.
The buildx plugin must match WOODPECKER_PLUGINS_PRIVILEGED on the Woodpecker server (exact tag, managed in hnykda/server-files). Bumped by hand together with server-files, never here.
